title: Plainer words
summary: No new features this time. The planner works exactly as it did - we rewrote the words on it.
i1: Every screen got read again, from the first sign-in to the assistant's replies. Buttons say what they do, errors say what happened and what to do next, and the Polish reads like Polish rather than a translation of the English. Nothing moved and nothing got renamed.
i2: The landing page used to show a drawing of the planner. Now it shows the planner itself - three short loops of a real hall being measured, reshaped, and reseated.
